name: astro-static-studio
description: Offline-first static website CMS & Astro builder with Android APK, iOS, and cross-platform Node CLI support

scripts.dev: npm run build -w apps/admin && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build -w apps/admin
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build -w apps/admin && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run build -w apps/admin && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run build -w apps/admin && npx cap sync ios
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --jsx react-jsx --strict --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule --skipLibCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions apps/admin/src/*.ts apps/admin/src/*.tsx apps/api/src/*.ts packages/contracts/src/*.ts packages/theme/src/*.ts packages/theme/src/studio/*.ts
